label: Availability
intent: The open slot is pulled out to be picked. Light: the free slot slides out to the right, hits its stop, recoils a little and settles, and stays open; the two busy slots never move. Strong: the slot is pushed in first, then pulled out hard to its stop and settles in two beats. The reverse pushes it home against its stop.

busy-bottom.//: a filled pill that grows with the weight: a fill plus an edge stroked at the weight
